test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

May you be blessed with good health.

options.text: You should be blessed with good health.
May God bless you with good health.
God should bless you with good health.

solution:
The correct answer is Option 3)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "May you be blessed with good health" is in the** passive voice.**
 
• To convert it into the active voice, we need to identify the agent performing the action.
 
• In this context, the implied agent is "**God"** or a **higher power.**

Hence, the correct active form is: **"May God bless you with good health."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When converting passive voice to active voice, **identify** the agent performing the action and restructure the sentence accordingly.
 
• In sentences expressing wishes or blessings, the agent is often implied and can be a higher power or deity.
 
• Ensure that the sentence maintains its original meaning and context after conversion.
